goal:
The `orders` crate in this project has three defects. `cargo test` fails.

Read the code, work out what is wrong, and fix the crate so every test passes.

The defects are spread across `src/parse.rs`, `src/total.rs` and `src/rank.rs` — each file has exactly one. Each failing test names the behaviour that is wanted.

Do not change `src/tests.rs`: the tests describe the behaviour, and editing them is not a fix. Do not rewrite the modules wholesale, and do not add dependencies — repair what is broken and keep the existing style, including that money stays integer pence.

Verify by running: cargo test. Report the exit code you actually saw and how many tests ran.
